semantic_units.text: The Smart FIFO block serves to provide FIFO storage and AHB/memory access in mutually exclusive Unique or Multiple modes, including sub-FIFO depth/addressing and tagged Sensor Hub data formatting.
The Smart FIFO block accepts Digital samples, FIFO mode configuration.
The Smart FIFO block produces Buffered samples and FIFO status flags.
The user selects the Multiple FIFO mode setting to 1 the first bit into the FIFO CFG MODE and 0 for the Unique FIFO mode.

The FIFO Controller haves a 6 i depth input of 8 bit to be used in Multiple FIFO Mode to define the depth of each subFIFOs and an AHB Slave Interface connected to the AHB BUS and a Memory Master Interface connected to the Physical Memory.
The FIFO Controller can address 1.5 kbyte divided into 32-bit address.
The FIFO Controller works at 16 MHz clock frequency.
As default, the FIFO works in Unique FIFO Mode.
The parameter MEM LOC defines the first Memory Location of the FIFO RAM: 0xC4000.
If input signal HMASTER is set to 0 or 1, the FIFO Controller enters Memory mode.
The FIFO register map first memory location is defined as MEM LOC + 0x1000: 0xC5000.
